source_audit.counting_rule: Count a material claim group once only when edition citation mapping links that same substantive claim to at least one primary/original source trail and at least one independent source trail in sources.json. Citation occurrences and source records are not claims. Complementary sources that do not independently check the same claim, institutional routes with no published current claim, and UNKNOWN statements are excluded.
source_audit.primary_source_trail_rule: Count source-ledger records whose source_type explicitly identifies a primary source or an original research article; do not include independent, authoritative-explainer, or expert-review records.
